correctness.rationale: Each valid placement has exactly one queen per row and column, so is a permutation with pairwise distinct i+p_i and i-p_i. Exhausting all 8!=40320 permutations yields 92 states; pairwise Hamming distances exhaust 4186 unordered pairs. Independently rebuilt both threshold graphs and exact-five graph; all-source BFS returned G4=168 edges, components [84,2,2,2,2], G5=464 edges and pair distances 464,2002,1704,16 and eccentricities 68 at 3,24 at 4; exact-five=296 edges and pair distances 296,1178,1968,720,24 and eccentricities 68 at 4,24 at 5. These are complete finite-state proofs for the defined 8x8 board, not a statement for all n.

value.rationale: The classical eight-queens feasible configuration space is a natural finite reconfiguration object, and sharp k-step connectivity, exceptional components, exact shortest paths and an exactly-five restriction answer a meaningful constrained-mobility question. These quantities are not obtained merely by knowing 92 solutions or their dihedral orbit count; the finite census is exact and complete rather than an arbitrary sample.

final_claim: For the complete 92-solution eight-queens state space, the graph connecting feasible placements differing on at most five occupied squares is connected, whereas the four-change graph has components 84,2,2,2,2; G5 diameter four and exact-five graph diameter five with all stated shortest-path enumerators.
